description: Returns the signed-in partner's own monthly statement of account for `period` (YYYY-MM) exactly as it was sent to them: `format` `pdf` (default) returns the PDF as an embedded file, `csv` returns the CSV as text in `csv`. Statements exist only for months already issued; any other month returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Read-only. Needs a signed-in partner credit-line account session; guest sessions have no credit line.
name: get_statement_document
title: Get Statement Document
